patch_description: The current ansatz has decent parameter efficiency (10 distinct params) but is showing a train-test gap (0.05→0.10 in generalization). The recommendation suggests expanding the Ising entangler set with two diagonal connections: ZZ[0,3] and XX[2,7]. This improves the qubit coupling graph coverage from a bipartite-like structure to include longer-range interactions, which helps the classifier separate difficult samples better (improving worst_group_margin). Historical data shows this transition (6→8 unique two-qubit params at similar depths) tightens worst-group margins and lifts test accuracy. We add only 2 new distinct parameters, so parameter efficiency remains competitive while robustness improves.
